import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 5, "due_date": 120, "weight": 6},
    1: {"processing_time": 99, "due_date": 90, "weight": 9},
    2: {"processing_time": 26, "due_date": 74, "weight": 8},
    3: {"processing_time": 50, "due_date": 106, "weight": 1},
    4: {"processing_time": 30, "due_date": 72, "weight": 1}
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0  # Suppress output

# Number of jobs
n = len(jobs)

# Variables
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # x[i,j] = 1 if job i is in position j
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion time of job i
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness of job i

# Objective: Minimize the sum of weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["weight"] * T[i] for i in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
# Each job is assigned to exactly one position
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="job_assignment")

# Each position is occupied by exactly one job
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(n)) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="position_occupation")

# Calculate completion times
model.addConstrs((C[i] == gp.quicksum(jobs[k]["processing_time"] * x[k, j] for k in range(n) for j in range(j+1))
                  for i in range(n)), name="completion_time")

# Calculate tardiness
model.addConstrs((T[i] >= C[i] - jobs[i]["due_date"] for i in range(n)), name="tardiness")
model.addConstrs((T[i] >= 0 for i in range(n)), name="non_negative_tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the job sequence
sequence = [None] * n
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence[j] = i

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result as JSON
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
```
